explication: Compound Engineering is an AI coding-agent skills plugin and companion CLI. The primary workflow is a host invoking brainstorm, plan, work, simplify, review, and compound skills; the resulting learning is written to docs/solutions/ and reused by later planning. Separately, the CLI parses Claude plugins, converts them into supported agent formats, and installs or cleans up generated artifacts. The skill internals are represented from README capabilities; sampled source primarily confirms parsing, target dispatch, conversion, writing, and cleanup behavior.
